cards.name: Chikorita
cards.description: It uses the leaf on its head to determine the temperature and humidity. It loves to sunbathe.

cards.name: Growlithe
cards.description: It has a brave and trustworthy nature. It fearlessly stands up to bigger and stronger foes.

cards.name: Arcanine
cards.description: Its magnificent bark conveys a sense of majesty. Anyone hearing it can't help but grovel before it.

cards.name: Numel
cards.description: The magma in its body reaches 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit. Its hump gets smaller when it uses Fire-type moves.

cards.name: Camerupt
cards.description: If angered, the humps on its back erupt in a shower of molten lava. It lives in the craters of volcanoes.

cards.name: Heatmor
cards.description: It draws in air through its tail, transforms it into fire, and uses it like a tongue. It melts Durant and eats them.

cards.name: Psyduck
cards.description: It has mystical powers but doesn't recall that it has used them. That is why it always looks puzzled.

cards.name: Golduck
cards.description: The forelegs are webbed, helping to make it an adept swimmer. It can be seen swimming elegantly in lakes, etc.

cards.name: Slowpoke
cards.description: It lazes vacantly near water. If something bites its tail, it won't even notice for a whole day.

cards.name: Bayleef
cards.description: The buds that ring its neck give off a spicy aroma that perks people up.

cards.name: Slowbro
cards.description: When a Slowpoke went hunting in the sea, its tail was bitten by a Shellder. That made it evolve into Slowbro.

cards.name: Slowking
cards.description: When its head was bitten, toxins entered Slowpoke's head and unlocked an extraordinary power.

cards.name: Shellder
cards.description: Clamping on to an opponent reveals its vulnerable parts, so it uses this move only as a last resort.

cards.name: Shellder
cards.description: Clamping on to an opponent reveals its vulnerable parts, so it uses this move only as a last resort.

cards.name: Cloyster
cards.description: Its shell is extremely hard. It cannot be shattered, even with a bomb. The shell opens only when it is attacking.

cards.name: Staryu
cards.description: It appears in large numbers by seashores. At night, its central core flashes with a red light.

cards.name: Lapras
cards.description: Its high intelligence enables it to understand human speech. It likes to ferry people on its back.

cards.name: Corsola
cards.description: They prefer unpolluted southern seas. Their coral branches lose their color and deteriorate in dirty water.

cards.name: Meganium
cards.description: Meganium's breath has the power to revive dead grass and plants. It can make them healthy again.

cards.name: Suicune
cards.description: Said to be the embodiment of north winds, it can instantly purify filthy, murky water.

cards.name: Tympole
cards.description: By vibrating its cheeks, it emits sound waves imperceptible to humans. It uses the rhythm of these sounds to talk.

cards.name: Palpitoad
cards.description: It lives in the water and on land. It uses its long, sticky tongue to immobilize its opponents.

cards.name: Seismitoad
cards.description: They shoot paralyzing liquid from their head bumps. They use vibration to hurt their opponents.

cards.name: Ducklett
cards.description: They are better at swimming than flying, and they happily eat their favorite food, peat moss, as they dive underwater.

cards.name: Swanna
cards.description: Swanna start to dance at dusk. The one dancing in the middle is the leader of the flock.

cards.name: Froakie
cards.description: It protects its skin by covering its body in delicate bubbles. Beneath its happy-go-lucky air, it keeps a watchful eye on its surroundings.

cards.name: Frogadier
cards.description: Its swiftness is unparalleled. It can scale a tower of more than 2,000 feet in a minute's time.

cards.name: Seedot
cards.description: When it dangles from a tree branch, it looks just like an acorn. It enjoys scaring other Pokémon.

cards.name: Greninja
cards.description: It appears and vanishes with a ninja's grace. It toys with its enemies using swift movements, while slicing them with throwing stars of sharpest water.

cards.name: Electabuzz
cards.description: It loves to feed on strong electricity. It occasionally appears around large power plants and so on.

cards.name: Electivire
cards.description: It pushes the tips of its two tails against the foe, then lets loose with over 20,000 volts of power.

cards.name: Shinx
cards.description: All of its fur dazzles if danger is sensed. It flees while the foe is momentarily blinded.

cards.name: Luxio
cards.description: Strong electricity courses through the tips of its sharp claws. A light scratch causes fainting in foes.

cards.name: Luxray
cards.description: Luxray's ability to see through objects comes in handy when it's scouting for danger.

cards.name: Blitzle
cards.description: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use the frequency and rhythm of these flashes to communicate.

cards.name: Zebstrika
cards.description: They have lightning-like movements. When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates.

cards.name: Kricketot
cards.description: When its antennae hit each other, it sounds like the music of a xylophone.

cards.name: Drowzee
cards.description: If you think that you had a good dream but you can't remember it, a Drowzee has probably eaten it.

cards.name: Hypno
cards.description: Seeing its swinging pendulum can induce sleep in three seconds, even in someone who just woke up.

cards.name: Skorupi
cards.description: It burrows under the sand to lie in wait for prey. Its tail claws can inject its prey with a savage poison.

cards.name: Drapion
cards.description: It has the power in its clawed arms to make scrap of a car. The tips of its claws release poison.

cards.name: Sigilyph
cards.description: The guardians of an ancient city, they always fly the same route while keeping watch for invaders.

cards.name: Trubbish
cards.description: Inhaling the gas they belch will make you sleep for a week. They prefer unsanitary places.

cards.name: Garbodor
cards.description: Consuming garbage makes new kinds of poison gases and liquids inside their bodies.

cards.name: Espurr
cards.description: It has enough psychic energy to blast everything within 300 feet of itself, but it has no control over its power.

cards.name: Meowstic
cards.description: The eyeball patterns on the interior of its ears emit psychic energy. It keeps the patterns tightly covered because that power is too immense.

cards.name: Kricketune
cards.description: It signals its emotions with its melodies. Scientists are studying these melodic patterns.

cards.name: Honedge
cards.description: If anyone dares to grab its hilt, it wraps a blue cloth around that person's arm and drains that person's life energy completely.

cards.name: Doublade
cards.description: The complex attack patterns of its two swords are unstoppable, even for an opponent greatly accomplished at swordplay.

cards.name: Aegislash
cards.description: Apparently, it can detect innate qualities of leadership. According to legend, whoever it recognizes is destined to become king.

cards.name: Skrelp
cards.description: It looks just like rotten kelp. It hides from foes while storing up power for its evolution.

cards.name: Phantump
cards.description: According to old tales, these Pokémon are stumps possessed by the spirits of children who died while lost in the forest.

cards.name: Trevenant
cards.description: Using its roots as a nervous system, it controls the trees in the forest. It's kind to the Pokémon that reside in its body.

cards.name: Sudowoodo
cards.description: It disguises itself as a tree to avoid attack. It hates water, so it will disappear if it starts raining.

cards.name: Gible
cards.description: It nests in small, horizontal holes in cave walls. It pounces to catch prey that stray too close.

cards.name: Gabite
cards.description: As it digs to expand its nest, it habitually digs up gems that it then hoards in its nest.

cards.name: Petilil
cards.description: Since they prefer moist, nutrient-rich soil, the areas where Petilil live are known to be good for growing plants.

cards.name: Garchomp
cards.description: It flies at speeds equals to a jet fighter plane. It never allows its prey to escape.

cards.name: Pancham
cards.description: It does its level best to glare and pull a scary face, but it can't help grinning if anyone pats its head.

cards.name: Nuzleaf
cards.description: It lives deep in forests. With the leaf on its head, it makes a flute whose song makes listeners uneasy.

cards.name: Shiftry
cards.description: By flapping its leafy fan, it can whip up gusts of 100 feet per second that can level houses.

cards.name: Pangoro
cards.description: It charges ahead and bashes its opponents like a berserker, uncaring about any hits it might take. Its arms are mighty enough to snap a telephone pole.

cards.name: Mawile
cards.description: Attached to its head is a huge set of jaws formed by horns. It can chew through iron beams.

cards.name: Ferroseed
cards.description: It absorbs the iron it finds in the rock while clinging to the ceiling. It shoots spikes when in danger.

cards.name: Lilligant
cards.description: Even veteran Trainers face a challenge in getting its beautiful flower to bloom. This Pokémon is popular with celebrities.

cards.name: Ferrothorn
cards.description: They attach themselves to cave ceilings, firing steel spikes at targets passing beneath them.

cards.name: Clefairy
cards.description: The moonlight that it stores in the wings on its back apparently gives it the ability to float in midair.

cards.name: Clefable
cards.description: A timid fairy Pokémon that is rarely seen, it will run and hide the moment it senses people.

cards.name: Spritzee
cards.description: In the past, rather than using perfume, royal ladies carried a Spritzee that would waft a fragrance they liked.

cards.name: Aromatisse
cards.description: Its scent is so overpowering that, unless a Trainer happens to really enjoy the smell, he or she will have a hard time walking alongside it.

cards.name: Dragalge
cards.description: Tales are told of ships that wander into seas where Dragalge live, never to return.

cards.name: Rattata
cards.description: Its fangs are long and very sharp. They grow continuously, so it gnaws on hard things to whittle them down.

cards.name: Raticate
cards.description: The webs on its hind legs enable it to cross rivers. It searches wide areas for food.

cards.name: Durant
cards.description: They attack in groups, covering themselves in steel armor to protect themselves from Heatmor.

cards.name: Dunsparce
cards.description: It digs into the ground with its tail and makes a mazelike nest. It can fly just a little.

cards.name: Stantler
cards.description: The curved antlers subtly change the flow of air to create a strange space where reality is distorted.

cards.name: Glameow
cards.description: When it's happy, Glameow demonstrates beautiful movements of its tail, like a dancing ribbon.

cards.name: Purugly
cards.description: To make itself appear intimidatingly beefy, it tightly cinches its waist with its twin tails.

cards.name: Furfrou
cards.description: Historically, in the Kalos region, these Pokémon were the designated guardians of the king.
